firmware.note: CircuitPython on the board, fox-bench's foxlib and a network-fox template (Wi-Fi beacon, Wi-Fi probe, BLE beacon) deployed over the REPL. The SoC's own radio: no module. The board variant sets the CircuitPython build and the LED / battery pins; a connected board's reported id picks it (the XIAO C5 ships on the DevKitC-1-N8R8 build; the merged image is written at 0x0). On the bench 2026-11-24: all five network templates from .mpy with 8.2 MB free; 5 GHz receive seen in the fox's own scan, a 5 GHz AP (channel 36) not yet tried.
